FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Blinds & Drapes Co., we specialize in the retail and installation of high-quality window treatments and blinds for both residential and light commercial properties. Our core operations involve sourcing a wide variety of products, including custom blinds, drapes, shades, and shutters to meet the diverse aesthetic needs of our clients. All installation activities are performed by trained and certified personnel to ensure compliance with safety standards and reduce the risk of improper installation. We emphasize quality and regulatory compliance through documented training programs, enhancing the skills and safety protocols of our installation teams. Our commitment to customer satisfaction is reflected in our efficient scheduling and management systems, which streamline service delivery and communication with clients. Additionally, we maintain strong relationships with established manufacturers to guarantee product quality and consistency. All installation projects are subject to strict guidelines, and we do not engage in electrical work or use subcontractors who do not hold valid licenses or insurance, adhering to all regulations to mitigate liability and uphold the highest standards in our operations.

Our business specializes in providing custom window treatments and blinds, and we also take pride in offering installation services that are performed by our experienced staff, who have developed their skills through hands-on experience in the field.
